escape_string_for_solr_query: escape special characters in a string to make it safe for use in a Solr query
get_wikidata_id_from_link_name: look up a Wikidata ID from a Wikipedia link title using a cached pickle mapping file
load_dev_datasets_with_wikidata_ids: load CoNLL benchmark datasets and annotate each mention with its gold Wikidata ID
extract_sentence_context_for_mention: extract the previous, current, and next sentence context around a mention for query building
build_mention_list_with_context: build a flat list of mentions from datasets with Solr-escaped context and sentence-level features
